answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity to a refundable stake plus a history of peer-verified work before it can earn or vote. A newcomer starts in an open meadow where anyone may join, but rewards stay small until honest jobs accumulate; creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand reputations, while a single honest agent grows steadily. Like a zephyr that only bends strong grass, cheap sybil floods pass without moving the market, because trust is earned through verifiable work over time, not claimed by sheer numbers.
